cover.title: vlncy.com
cover.subtitle: Technical SEO, on-page SEO, AI readiness, backlinks, UI/UX, accessibility and architecture analysis.

sections.text: This audit reviews vlncy.com across seven dimensions. The site is fundamentally healthy: Core Web Vitals pass and best practices score well. The largest opportunities sit in image delivery, accessibility labelling, and AI readiness, where quick wins are available before launch traffic scales.

sections.title: Technical SEO
sections.description: Crawlability, indexation, sitemaps, redirects and site health as seen by search engine bots.

items.title: Sitemap contains 404 URLs
items.impact: 4 dead URLs waste crawl budget and signal poor maintenance
items.recommendation: Regenerate the sitemap on deploy and remove retired URLs.

items.title: Inefficient cache lifetimes on static assets
items.impact: Est savings of 4,659 KiB on repeat visits
items.recommendation: Set long Cache-Control max-age with content-hashed filenames.

sections.title: On-Page SEO
sections.description: Titles, meta descriptions, heading structure, content quality and internal linking.

items.title: Heading order not sequential
items.impact: Weakens document outline for crawlers and assistive tech
items.recommendation: Restructure headings to descend h1, h2, h3 without skips.

sections.title: AI SEO
sections.description: Readiness for AI-driven discovery: structured data, agent browsability, and machine-readable content.

items.title: No structured data markup
items.impact: AI assistants and rich results cannot extract entity information
items.recommendation: Add JSON-LD Organization and WebSite schema to all pages.

sections.title: Backlinks
sections.description: Authority profile: referring domains, link quality and anchor distribution.

sections.text: The profile is small but clean, typical for a pre-launch product. Priority is earning links from press coverage at launch rather than remediation.

sections.title: UI / UX
sections.description: Visual hierarchy, interaction patterns, mobile experience and conversion friction.

items.title: Layout shift risk from unsized images
items.impact: Content can jump during load on slow connections
items.recommendation: Add explicit width and height attributes to all images.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.description: WCAG conformance: labels, contrast, keyboard navigation and screen reader experience.

items.title: Images missing alt attributes
items.impact: Screen readers cannot describe images (34 affected)
items.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text; empty alt for decorative images.

items.title: Insufficient colour contrast
items.impact: Text may be illegible for low-vision users
items.recommendation: Meet WCAG AA ratio of 4.5:1 for body text.

sections.title: Architecture Analysis
sections.description: Site structure, URL design, page depth, redirects and rendering strategy.

sections.text: The structure is shallow and clean. The main architectural recommendation is server-side rendering or prerendering for the marketing pages, which benefits performance, SEO, and AI agent readability simultaneously.
